tools.name: LOVO AI
tools.commission: 20% recurring commission on referred new customers for 24 months
tools.payout_terms: Paid monthly; current public program page does not expose the payout method in visible text
tools.eligibility: No minimum sales requirement; application asks for primary platform, audience/followers and promotion approach; approval is described as taking about one week
tools.evidence_summary: Current official LOVO affiliate page confirms free signup, no minimum sales requirement, 20% recurring commission for 24 months, monthly payments, and unique affiliate links after approval.

tools.name: n8n
tools.commission: 30% on n8n Cloud referrals for 12 months
tools.payout_terms: Monthly via PayPal; minimum payable balance EUR 100
tools.eligibility: Official page says anyone can become an n8n affiliate; program rewards Cloud Starter and Pro referrals
tools.evidence_summary: Current official n8n affiliate and partners pages confirm open application, unique affiliate URL after approval, 30% revenue share for 12 months, monthly PayPal payout, and EUR 100 payout threshold.

tools.name: Novita AI
tools.commission: 10% of each referral's spending for the first 180 days
tools.eligibility: Official page targets developers/tech enthusiasts, entrepreneurs/founders, AI influencers and audiences interested in AI models/GPU infrastructure; signup requires acceptance of program terms
tools.evidence_summary: Current official Novita AI pages confirm a live affiliate portal, 10% commission on referral spend for 180 days, a 60-day cookie, and automatic affiliate credentials for existing Novita accounts. Payout terms were not inferred because they were not shown in the current public materials retrieved.

tools.name: Followr
tools.commission: 25% recurring commission on successful referred sales
tools.payout_terms: Managed through PushLap Growth; exact public payout schedule/threshold not stated in the current official help article
tools.eligibility: Official help center says available globally with no restrictions; intended for entrepreneurs, creators, agencies, freelancers, influencers and automation audiences
tools.evidence_summary: Current official Followr Help Center confirms an active PushLap Growth affiliate portal, 25% recurring commissions, unique referral links and global availability.

tools.name: Colossyan
tools.commission: Starts at 25% recurring commission and scales by tier up to 50%; commissions last up to one year
tools.payout_terms: Monthly; Wise preferred with PayPal available under certain conditions
tools.eligibility: Application required; affiliates receive a personalized tracking link and dashboard after approval
tools.evidence_summary: Current official Colossyan affiliate page confirms 25% starting recurring commission, tiers up to 50%, commissions lasting up to one year, a 90-day cookie, monthly payouts, Wise as preferred payout method and PayPal under some conditions.
